name: Jecisc
intro: I'm Jecisc, a red dragon from the north of France.
description: I'm a red dragon from the north of France. I guard a hoard of gold, chocolate and Blåhaj, and I take my naps very seriously. I'm sociable, kind and caring, but don't tell anyone.
linksIntro: Say hi. I answer faster when there is chocolate involved.
tagline: Red dragon from the north of France. I hoard gold, chocolate, Blåhaj and naps. Sarcastic, stubborn, secretly kind.
artIntro: Me, as drawn by people far more patient than I am. Each piece is credited to its artist. A few hide behind a curtain: peek only if you are 18 or older.
myArtIntro: When I am not napping on my hoard, I make things: embroidery, pencil drawings of animals, and painted miniature teams.
stickersIntro: Some say that images are worth thousand words :)
notFoundTitle: I sat on this page. It's mine now.
notFoundText: Whatever was here is part of my hoard. You can still visit the rest.
